plans.idea: Classic leaderboard reading left to right: a readable logo lockup anchors the left, the headline is the large central focal point, and the CTA sits on one line flush to the right edge with even gutters between all three.
Headline-led: the headline takes the whole left half as the dominant element, and the brand and action form one tight sign-off group on the right (logo next to a one-line CTA).
Message-then-signature: the headline and the CTA sit side by side as one message unit in the left and centre, and the logo closes the strip at the far right like a brand sign-off.
